beaches.name: Vithisma
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported across the beach, with clothed visitors occasional. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2000 to August 2025 describing it as regularly 100 percent naturist; access is a steep path ending in a ladder.

beaches.name: Mikros Mourtias
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix on the bay below Old Alonissos village. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2015 to August 2025; a 2015 report says an island map sold in Patitiri and a multilingual sign on a ruined house mark it as a nudist beach.

beaches.name: Spartines Bay
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on the third beach of the bay. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2017 to August 2025; a 2017 report describes an objection to nudity on the middle beach, with locals pointing to the third beach as the nude one.
